tei:div.tei:p: But we are Thy people, children of Thy covenant, children of Abraham who loved Thee, whom Thou didst make a promise on Mount Moriah, the seed of Isaac, his only son, who was bound on the altar, the congregation of Jacob, Thy firstborn son, whose name, out of Thy love with which Thou didst love him, and out of Thy joy with which Thou didst rejoice in him, Thou hast called Israel and Yeshurun.
